diagnosis_summary: Rock 18.3.5's Workflow Control > Electronic Signature action generates and saves the signed PDF BinaryFile without assigning ParentEntityId or ParentEntityTypeId, then links that file to the new SignatureDocument. GetFile.ashx treats a file without both parent fields as having no parent authorization context and can fall back to BinaryFile security, where a non-authorized staff user receives HTTP 403. An earlier v16.1 migration backfilled signature-document files with their SignatureDocumentTemplate parent, confirming the intended ownership shape. This identifies one affected creation path; it does not prove that every affected file or missing Signed By value has the same cause. The issue remains open with no upstream fix recorded.
workaround_summaries: No supported public no-write workaround or upstream fix is currently recorded. Do not reproduce the reporter's direct production SQL update. If access is operationally urgent, use normal administrative access while a separately reviewed application-level remediation and data repair are tested in staging, backed up, and approved.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether an instance has signature-document files missing their intended template parent and whether the workflow-backed Electronic Signature creation path can produce them, without opening documents or changing data.
prerequisites: Know the exact installed Rock version or build ancestry.
Have read-only access to aggregate SignatureDocument and BinaryFile metadata.
Know whether Workflow Control > Electronic Signature is used to create signed documents.

steps.title: Check the workflow creation path
steps.instructions: Inspect the installed Workflow Control Electronic Signature action. Confirm whether CreateSignedDocumentPdf assigns the generated BinaryFile's ParentEntityId to the SignatureDocumentTemplate ID and ParentEntityTypeId to the SignatureDocumentTemplate entity type before saving.
steps.expected_if_affected: The action saves the BinaryFile without assigning both parent fields, matching the affected Rock 18.3.5 source path.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed path explicitly assigns both template-parent fields before the BinaryFile is saved, or the workflow action is not used to create these documents.
evidence_to_record: template-parent assignment present yes or no
workflow Electronic Signature action used yes or no

steps.title: Count missing parent metadata
steps.instructions: Return aggregate counts only. Do not return file IDs, names, paths, people, registrations, templates, signatures, or document content.
steps.probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS SignatureDocumentFileCount, SUM(CASE WHEN [bf].[ParentEntityId] IS NULL OR [bf].[ParentEntityTypeId] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MissingParentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ([bf].[ParentEntityId] IS NULL OR [bf].[ParentEntityTypeId] IS NULL) AND [sd].[SignedByPersonAliasId] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MissingParentAndSignerCount FROM [BinaryFile] AS [bf] INNER JOIN [SignatureDocument] AS [sd] ON [sd].[BinaryFileId] = [bf].[Id]
steps.expected_if_affected: MissingParentCount is greater than zero. MissingParentAndSignerCount may measure the reporter's observed correlation but does not establish causation.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: MissingParentCount is zero for the current signature-document population.

steps.title: Check the download authorization path
steps.instructions: Confirm that the installed GetFile handler calls ParentEntityAllowsView and, when no parent is present, evaluates BinaryFile authorization or a security grant for file types requiring view security.
steps.expected_if_affected: Missing parent metadata sends the request through the BinaryFile authorization fallback that can deny the impersonated staff user.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed handler has a separately documented authorization path that safely resolves SignatureDocumentTemplate ownership when the file parent fields are absent.
evidence_to_record: fallback security path present yes or no

limitations: Aggregate counts do not identify which creation path produced a file and do not prove that a specific user receives HTTP 403.
Do not open signed documents, export file metadata, impersonate a production user, change security, or update BinaryFile rows solely to reproduce this issue.
A missing SignedByPersonAliasId may be valid for an anonymous signer and is not established as the cause of missing parent metadata.

context.scope: signed PDFs created by Workflow Control > Electronic Signature and downloaded by a user who depends on parent-template authorization
